definitions.explanation: A single grain of rice. Also used figuratively as an image of something extremely tiny.

examples.japanese: {茶碗|ちゃわん}に{米粒|こめつぶ}が{残|のこ}っている。
examples.english: There are grains of rice left in the bowl.

examples.japanese: {米粒|こめつぶ}を{一|ひと}つも{残|のこ}さず{食|た}べなさい。
examples.english: Eat every last grain of rice.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}から{見|み}ると、{人|ひと}が{米粒|こめつぶ}のように{小|ちい}さく{見|み}えた。
examples.english: From the airplane, the people looked as tiny as grains of rice.

notes:
Compound of {米|こめ} (uncooked rice) + {粒|つぶ} (grain). Commonly used in the simile {米粒|こめつぶ}のよう (like a grain of rice) to describe something very small.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {米粒|こめつぶ}を{残|のこ}す: leave grains of rice (uneaten)
- {米粒|こめつぶ}ほどの{大|おお}きさ: the size of a grain of rice
- {米粒|こめつぶ}のように{小|ちい}さい: as small as a grain of rice
